name: task-progress-android
description: Task Progress for Android (Capacitor wrapper around the same dashboard code)

scripts.sync: node tools/make-www.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: node tools/make-www.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: node tools/make-www.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
